challenge.method: Challenge whether the tag is merely a working draft, and whether API queries, schema declarations, response serialization, or an implementation collapse into one entity. Read October 2021 sections 2.1 and 3 through 7, compare the 2025 edition introduction, inspect the two pinned specimens, and search the frozen canonical entity registry for matching names and IDs.
challenge.results: The tagged README retains a Working Draft banner but the October 2021 specification independently identifies the released edition. The published document assigns executable and type-system definitions to GraphQL. Execution and the response contract remain edition-scoped, and external transport and serialization choices do not form the notation. The specimens illustrate both source forms, and the frozen entity registry contains no matching name or proposed ID.
